raiden.initial:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: new production 2D action-game sprite atlas for Raiden Shogun's upward lightning-call skill. Input image 1 is character identity/outfit reference; input image 2 is matching in-game painting style and proportions, not an edit target. Create a NEW square atlas, EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, four keyframes in row-major order. Genuinely transparent RGBA background. Every invisible equal cell contains one whole-body Raiden with complete katana, in side-view three-quarter camera facing RIGHT. Same character anatomy and body scale in all four frames. Refined Japanese fantasy anime painting, sharp readable silhouettes, detailed lavender short kimono, violet sleeves, gold hair ornaments, long violet braid, red obi, dark thigh-highs, purple shoes, violet katana. Do not change identity or costume. Sparse atlas: standing body only 48 percent of cell height, complete body plus sword fits within central 70 percent of each cell. Huge truly transparent gutters on all sides. Feet at 82 percent of each cell's height, torso normally centered at 45 percent width. Full sword tip and hair must stay well inside its own cell. Fixed scale, do not enlarge crouches.
Top-left WINDUP: knees slightly bent, one foot forward to right, sword raised diagonally from near chest toward upper right, shoulders preparing to raise the blade. Top-right CONTACT: fully upright powerful stance, right sword arm extended ABOVE HEAD, katana points almost straight vertically UP, off hand outward for balance; this calls down thunder in front of her. Bottom-left FOLLOWTHROUGH: blade still elevated but arm lowering diagonally forward, torso turns slightly right, braid and sleeves flowing from the completed upward gesture. Bottom-right RECOVER: relaxed grounded guard, sword lowered diagonally right at hip, shoulders settle, both knees gently bent. All four poses visibly distinct in arm, shoulder and leg positions; do NOT repeat artwork. NO lightning columns, giant auras, spell circles, particles or motion blur; these are separate VFX. Only tiny subtle violet edge light on actual sword. NO text, labels, grid, dividers, checkerboard, floor, background, drop shadow. Four full characters only. Transparent padding is more important than filling canvas.

jean.initial:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D side-scrolling fantasy action game sprite atlas. Create a NEW two-column two-row square atlas of FOUR Jean character animation keyframes. Input 1 is Jean identity and costume reference, input 2 shows existing in-game artwork style, input 3 is the required sparse 2x2 layout reference (replace purple swordswoman with Jean). Jean's new skill is a rising upward sword-cut that creates an updraft; draw body and weapon ONLY, the spell effect is supplied separately. True RGBA transparency, absolutely no backdrop. Match refined Japanese fantasy anime painting, clean readable silhouettes. Blonde ponytail with dark ribbon, blue eyes, white-and-navy gold-edged knight uniform, dark gloves and boots, blue cape, one silver single-handed knight sword.
CRITICAL LAYOUT: four small fully isolated figures with enormous transparent gutters, exactly one in each equal square quadrant. Match sparse third reference: standing BODY height just 38% of each cell height, FULL silhouette including raised sword must fit central 65% of cell in both axes. Characters must NOT fill the canvas. Same anatomical scale across all four, fixed side-on three-quarter camera FACING RIGHT. Whole weapon never reaches a cell boundary. Feet at 79% down each cell, support stance centered at 50% across cell.
Row-major four poses: TOP-LEFT WINDUP: strong low crouch, sword held horizontally LOW in front of knees, blade tip points right, shoulders twisted to load upward cut. TOP-RIGHT CONTACT: right leg drives up to straighten stance, sword swings from low to HIGH diagonally upper right at about 60 degrees, extended right arm, torso opening upward, free hand behind for balance. BOTTOM-LEFT FOLLOWTHROUGH: tall stance, sword hand HIGH overhead with blade pointed diagonally upper left behind her as upward arc finishes, right-facing face and hips, left knee relaxed, cape flowing back left. BOTTOM-RIGHT RECOVER: steady guarded standing stance with sword lowered diagonally to right, hands close to body, cape settling. Four distinct limb and torso positions, clear animation sequence. Keep normal legs/anatomy, no duplicate figures in a cell. No large wind swirls, spell rings, lightning, smoke, particles, motion blur or shadows. No ground, grid, labels, text, checkerboard or panel. Only character and solid sword with a tiny pale teal edge gleam. Keep huge empty transparent space around each.

xiao.initial:

Match Xiao, teal-black spiky hair, golden eyes, forehead violet diamond, white sleeveless top, green arm tattoo, purple trousers, teal hanging sashes, yaksha mask on hip, jade-green spear. Do not modify the old atlas. This NEW ability is a HORIZONTAL RIGHTWARD THRUST, distinct from his downward plunge. NO wind trails, huge auras, rings, particles, smoke, motion blur or shadows. True RGBA transparent background, no floor, no grid or border, no text, no labels, no checkerboard. The entire shaft and single rightmost jade blade fit inside each quadrant.
